answer: Equivocation-proof bond stops mass forgery. Each identity locks 70 credits and files a key-signed claim in a glacier ledger. One key, one vine: a second claim from the same key is equivocation. A sparrow auditor samples claims; double-signing burns both bonds and bans the key 20 epochs. Filing costs 55; 1,000 fakes pay 55,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented keys fail: signing twice proves fraud. Honest agents file once, pay 55, keep their bond.
